main_text.p: כָּפַר[?] m. Pix, Gen.6.14. Expiatio, Redemptura, Redemptionis pretium, Exod.21.30. Vicus, Villa, 1.Sam.6.18. Cyprus, arbor odorata, Cantic.1.14. Alf. כְּפְרָא[?] Redempturam suam, Psal.49.8.
כָּפָר[?] m. Pagus: Vicus: Constr. כְּפַר, quod quibusdam est Proprium nomen, Josh.18.24. Plur. כְּפָרִים In pagis, vel, Ad cypros, Cant.7.11. וּבִכְפָרִים Et in pagis, 1.Par.27.25.
כָּפִיר[?] m. Idem: Plural. בִּכְפָרִים In vicis, vel aliquo vicorum, Nehem.6.2.
כְּפִיר m. Leo juvenis, prædari discens, Ezech.19.3. ubi à Catulo distinguitur. Plur. הַכְּפִירִים Juvenes-leones, Psal. 104.21. Aff. כְּפִירֵיהֶם Juvenes leones ejus, Ezech.38.13. Vide אַרְיֵה[?].
כָּפֹר m. Pruina, Psal.147.16. Crater: Pelvis, 1.Par.28.17. Plur. Constr. כְּפוֹרֵי וּלְכַפּוֹרֵי Et pro pelvibus, Ibid. כְּפוֹרֵי כֶּסֶף Crateres argentei, Esr.1.10.
כַּפֹּרֶת f. Propitiatorium, Expiatorium, Placatorium: Vocatur sic Operculum, Tegumentum arcæ fœderis, ex auro puro factum, quod illic Dominus propitium se ostende-ret, Exod.25.17.

כפש Hiph. הִכְפִּישׁ Deprefsit, Subegit. Præterit. הִכְפִּישַׁנִי Deprefit me, Thren.3.16. id est, כָּנַע כָּפָה · כֹּשׁ, juxta Hebræos quosdam. R.Sal. Operuit me, Cumulavit super me pulverem. Apud Rabbinos, מִדָּה כְּפוּשָׁה Mensura accumulata & pressa.

כפת Chald. יִכְפַּת[?] Vinxit, Ligavit. Præter. כְּפַתּו Vinxe-runt, Dan.3.21. Quidam ex Passivo Pehil exponunt, Vincti fuerunt. Pahel Infin. לְכַפָּתָה Ad ligandum, Dan.3.20. Partic. מְכַפְּתִין Ligati, Dan.3.23. In Targum quandoq; respondet Hebræo אָסַר.

page.notes: The large Hebrew letters at the start of the two entries (כפש and כפת) are entry headers printed as woodcut-style initials; they are transcribed in front of their entries. Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are hard to read at this scan resolution and are marked [?] where uncertain. The word "Vide" entry (אַרְיֵה) is partly illegible. The long s is printed throughout and has been written as plain s. The printed hyphens in "Redem-/pturam", "Juvenes-leones", "ostende-ret", "Vinxe-runt" are kept as printed.
